title: Extend --render to the prose mutating commands
findings_note: follow-on from S45, which scoped prose out

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
S45 added `--render` to the nine item-mutating commands but deliberately left the prose
commands out. `prose edit`, `prose add-pass`, and `prose drop-pass` all change the
rendered roadmap too, so after one of them `slicer check` is stale with no `--render` to
avoid the manual step — the same friction S45 removed everywhere else. The scope-out was
noted in S45's commit as a follow-on; this closes it.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. `prose edit REF --render` leaves `check` clean with no separate render.
2. `prose add-pass` and `prose drop-pass` accept `--render` the same way.
3. Read-only `prose list`/`show` do not gain the flag.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Reuse the `_mutating` wrapper and `_render_flag` helper from S45: wrap the three prose
mutating handlers and add `--render` to their subparsers. `prose list`/`show` stay
read-only and unwrapped.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: `slicer prose add-pass 2 --heading "# Pass 2" --render && slicer check` is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
One commit: wrap the three prose mutating handlers with `_mutating` and add
`--render` via `_render_flag` (cli.py), tests in test_prose.py. Reuses the S45
helpers.
